motion_beats: A pair of hands folds one soft sweater and places it into an open half-packed suitcase
artifact_risks: Anatomical hand errors, fabric morphing, texture boiling on knit fabric
loop_friendly: Yes - end on the same folded stack position as the start
example_prompt: Overhead flatlay shot, static locked-off camera. A pair of hands neatly folds a soft beige sweater and places it into an open, half-packed suitcase on a white bed. Consistent soft daylight from a window. Natural, slightly imperfect hand motion. No camera movement.

motion_beats: Hands roll a single t-shirt into a tight roll on a flat surface
artifact_risks: Fabric morphing, anatomical hand errors
loop_friendly: Yes - loop the roll motion at matching start/end shape
example_prompt: Close-up POV shot looking down at a pair of hands rolling a plain white t-shirt into a tight roll on a wooden table. Soft natural window light, consistent throughout. Slow, deliberate hand motion. Static camera, no movement.

motion_beats: A hand pulls a zipper along the top edge of a packed suitcase
artifact_risks: Object permanence on the zipper pull, fabric/seam morphing
example_prompt: Medium close-up, slow push-in camera move. A hand grips a zipper pull and drags it smoothly along the top edge of a fully packed tan suitcase lying on a bed. Warm afternoon light, consistent color temperature. Natural, steady hand motion.

motion_beats: A hand sets a closed passport down next to a boarding pass and sunglasses
artifact_risks: Text rendering failure on passport or ticket, object permanence
example_prompt: Overhead flatlay, static camera. A hand places a closed navy passport onto a light wood desk next to a folded boarding pass and a pair of sunglasses, passport cover facing up with print turned away from clear legibility. Bright even daylight. Minimal, gentle hand motion.

motion_beats: A hand presses a dropper of serum onto a cheek in one dab
artifact_risks: Face asymmetry, anatomical hand errors, over-smoothed waxy skin
loop_friendly: Yes - short 2-3 second loop works well
example_prompt: Close-up shot at eye level, static camera. A hand brings a glass dropper to a cheek and presses one drop of serum onto natural-textured skin. Soft diffused studio light, consistent and even. Natural skin texture, no airbrushed look. Brief, simple motion, 2-3 seconds.

shot_type: Medium close-up on hands and jaw
motion_beats: Hands smooth cream along the jawline in one upward stroke
artifact_risks: Face and hand distortion, waxy over-smoothed skin
example_prompt: Medium close-up, static camera. Two hands smooth a small amount of cream upward along a jawline in one gentle stroke. Consistent soft window light. Natural skin texture retained, not airbrushed. Slow, natural hand motion.

motion_beats: Fingertips pat a clay mask onto a cheek
artifact_risks: Face asymmetry, texture boiling on the mask surface
example_prompt: Close-up, static locked-off camera. Fingertips gently pat a thin layer of clay mask onto a cheek with natural, even skin texture underneath. Soft diffused lighting, no flicker. Brief, repetitive patting motion, kept simple.

motion_beats: A brush pulls through hair in one smooth stroke from root to end
artifact_risks: Hair strand morphing, ghosting or trailing on fast brush motion
loop_friendly: No - keep to one direction for realism
example_prompt: Medium shot, side profile, static camera. A wooden brush pulls slowly through long hair in a single smooth stroke from root to end. Warm soft lighting, consistent throughout. Slow motion speed to avoid a blurred or trailing brush.

motion_beats: Subject leans toward a mirror and tucks hair behind one ear
artifact_risks: Reflection mismatch, identity drift between subject and reflection
loop_friendly: No - mirrors are highest risk, keep brief
example_prompt: Medium shot, static camera, subject visible in a bathroom mirror reflection. She leans in slightly and tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. Even, bright bathroom lighting, one consistent light source. Brief, simple motion, kept to 2-3 seconds to limit reflection drift.

shot_type: Close-up POV top-down on cutting board
motion_beats: A knife slices one strawberry in a single controlled downward motion
artifact_risks: Anatomical hand and finger errors (high risk near a blade), object permanence, texture boiling on fruit flesh
loop_friendly: Yes - reset to a fresh piece each loop
example_prompt: Close-up top-down POV, static camera. A hand holds a strawberry steady while a knife makes one clean, slow downward slice through it on a wooden cutting board, blade moving away from the fingers. Bright natural daylight, consistent. Slow, deliberate single motion, no fast repeated chopping.

motion_beats: Water pours in a thin steady stream from a kettle into a coffee filter
artifact_risks: Fluid physics errors, ghosting on the falling water stream
loop_friendly: Yes - stream can loop if trimmed to a steady middle segment
example_prompt: Close-up, static camera. A thin, steady stream of water pours from a gooseneck kettle into a coffee filter and grounds below, water following natural gravity. Warm morning light, consistent color temperature. Slow, steady pouring motion.

shot_type: Medium close-up on hands and counter
motion_beats: Hands press and fold a ball of dough in one repeating motion
artifact_risks: Dough surface morphing, texture boiling
example_prompt: Medium close-up, static camera. Floured hands press and fold a ball of dough on a wooden counter in one slow, repeating motion. Soft natural daylight, consistent. Simple, natural hand motion, no fast movement.

motion_beats: A hand places a single garnish onto a finished plate
artifact_risks: Object permanence, anatomical hand errors
example_prompt: Overhead flatlay, static camera. A hand places a small sprig of fresh herb onto a finished plate of food as a final garnish. Bright, even natural light. Brief, simple placing motion.

motion_beats: Steamed milk pours into an espresso shot forming a simple pattern
artifact_risks: Fluid physics errors, texture boiling on the foam surface
loop_friendly: Yes - trim to the steady middle of the pour
example_prompt: Close-up top-down, static camera. Steamed milk pours in a thin, steady stream into a white cup of espresso, foam following natural fluid motion. Warm, consistent cafe lighting. Slow, controlled pour.

motion_beats: Hands smooth a duvet across a bed in one sweeping motion
artifact_risks: Fabric morphing, texture boiling on bedding pattern
example_prompt: Medium wide shot, static camera. Two hands smooth a white duvet flat across a made bed in one slow, even sweeping motion. Soft consistent morning light from a window. Natural, unhurried motion.

motion_beats: Hands fold one towel in half and then in half again
artifact_risks: Fabric morphing and warping (this niche's highest general risk), hand errors
example_prompt: Overhead shot, static camera. A pair of hands folds a plain towel in half, then in half again, on a bed covered in neatly folded laundry. Soft even daylight, consistent. Slow, simple folding motion.

motion_beats: A watering can tips to pour a thin stream of water onto a potted plant
artifact_risks: Fluid physics errors, object permanence on the spout
example_prompt: Medium shot, static camera. A watering can tips gently, pouring a thin stream of water onto the soil of a potted plant on a windowsill. Bright, consistent natural light. Slow, controlled pouring motion.

motion_beats: A match or lighter flame touches a candle wick until it catches
artifact_risks: Extreme temporal flicker (flame is the hardest element for every tool), flame morphing
loop_friendly: No - keep this shot brief rather than looping
example_prompt: Close-up, static camera. A lit match is brought to a candle wick, which catches and holds a small steady flame. Keep the flame small in frame and the shot under 2 seconds. Warm, dim ambient room light, consistent.

motion_beats: A hand places one book onto a shelf next to others
artifact_risks: Object permanence, background instability among shelf items
example_prompt: Medium shot, static camera. A hand slides one hardcover book into place on a shelf of neatly arranged books. Even, soft daylight. Simple background with few small objects to limit warping. Brief, simple motion.

motion_beats: One slow overhead arm stretch held for a moment
artifact_risks: Limb morphing during full-body movement, identity drift if shot runs long
loop_friendly: Yes - a short, symmetric stretch can loop
example_prompt: Medium shot, static camera, softly backlit by a window. A person reaches both arms slowly overhead in one gentle stretch and holds briefly. Natural, slightly imperfect motion. Keep the clip short and the stretch simple, one movement only.

motion_beats: Subject holds a static pose with only subtle breathing movement
artifact_risks: Minimal risk - lowest-risk fitness option due to near-stillness
example_prompt: Medium wide shot, static camera. A person holds a simple seated yoga pose, nearly still except for gentle natural breathing motion. Soft, even studio light, consistent throughout. Minimal motion overall.

shot_type: Close-up POV on hands and notebook
motion_beats: A pen writes a few lines across an open notebook page
artifact_risks: Text rendering failure (handwriting will not be legible - do not try to force it), hand errors
example_prompt: Close-up POV, static camera. A hand writes a few lines with a pen across an open notebook page; the handwriting is stylized and not meant to be readable. Warm desk lamp light, consistent. Slow, natural writing motion.

motion_beats: Subject sits nearly still with slow, steady breathing
artifact_risks: Face artifacts appear if held too long - keep the shot short and still
example_prompt: Medium close-up, static camera. A person sits with eyes closed, breathing slowly and evenly, face nearly still. Soft, even natural light, consistent. Very minimal motion, kept brief.

motion_beats: A hand adjusts one item into place within an arranged outfit
artifact_risks: Object permanence, texture boiling on patterned fabric
example_prompt: Overhead flatlay, static camera. A hand adjusts a folded scarf into place within a neatly arranged outfit laid out on a bed. Bright, even daylight. Minimal, simple adjusting motion.

motion_beats: Subject turns in one slow circle in front of a mirror
artifact_risks: Identity drift doubled by the reflection, fabric morphing during the spin, reflection mismatch
loop_friendly: No - highest-risk shot on this list, keep it short
example_prompt: Medium shot, static camera, subject visible in a full-length mirror. She turns in one slow, complete circle to show an outfit. Even, bright lighting matched between subject and reflection. Keep the clip short, under 3 seconds, to limit reflection drift.

motion_beats: Hands clasp a watch or necklace closed
artifact_risks: Anatomical hand errors, object permanence on the clasp mechanism
example_prompt: Close-up, static camera. A pair of hands fastens the clasp of a thin gold necklace. Soft, even light, consistent. Slow, careful hand motion.

motion_beats: Fingers type with only one or two fingers moving at a time
artifact_risks: Anatomical hand and finger errors (very high risk - many independent fingers), ghosting on fast keys
example_prompt: Close-up, static camera, angled to partially obscure full hand detail. Fingers type on a laptop keyboard with slow, deliberate keystrokes rather than fast typing. Warm desk lamp light, consistent. Minimal, controlled hand motion.

motion_beats: A hand places one pen into a cup of pens and pencils
artifact_risks: Object permanence, background instability among desk items
example_prompt: Overhead flatlay, static camera. A hand places a pen into a ceramic cup already holding a few pencils on an otherwise tidy desk. Even, soft daylight. Simple, uncluttered background. Brief, simple motion.

action: Pouring a hot drink at a desk
motion_beats: Liquid pours from a mug or teapot into a cup, with light steam rising
artifact_risks: Fluid physics errors, steam behaves like a light-flicker artifact - keep it subtle
example_prompt: Close-up, static camera. Tea pours in a steady stream from a small teapot into a mug, with a thin wisp of steam rising gently. Warm, consistent desk lamp lighting. Slow, controlled pour, steam kept subtle and minimal.

motion_beats: Subject walks at a natural, steady pace along a path
artifact_risks: Full-body limb morphing, background instability from foliage, identity drift over a longer duration
loop_friendly: No - keep this shot short rather than looping
example_prompt: Medium wide shot, slow tracking camera moving alongside the subject. A person walks at a natural, steady pace along a path scattered with a few fallen leaves. Soft overcast daylight, consistent. Simple background with limited foliage detail. Keep the clip short, one direction of travel only.

motion_beats: Liquid pours from a pitcher into a glass over ice
artifact_risks: Fluid physics errors, ghosting on any splash
loop_friendly: Yes - trim to the steady middle of the pour
example_prompt: Close-up, static camera. Lemonade pours in a steady stream from a glass pitcher into a glass filled with ice. Bright, even natural light. Slow, controlled pour with minimal splash.

motion_beats: Hands lift a lid straight up and off of a wrapped box
artifact_risks: Object permanence, anatomical hand errors
example_prompt: Close-up overhead shot, static camera. Two hands lift the lid straight up and off a ribbon-tied gift box, revealing tissue paper inside. Soft, warm indoor light, consistent. Slow, simple lifting motion.
